educationalGoal: Comprehensive study of support utilizing knowledge of psychology and clinical psychology. Acquire basic knowledge such as the history and concepts of some psychotherapy. Consider the role of psychotherapists in community support, mental health education, and stakeholder support. Learn the necessary communication methods as a psychotherapist. achievementLevels.ideal:
Understand the basics and theory of psychological support methods.
Select appropriate support methods for individuals, groups, communities, etc., and understand their roles and limitations.
Understand and appropriately explain the need for stakeholder support and mental health education.
Have basic communication skills and a sense of ethics as a psychotherapist. It can also be applied in psychotherapy settings.
achievementLevels.standard:
Understand the basics of psychological support.
Understand the role and limitations of support tailored to individuals, groups, communities, etc.
Explain the need for support to stakeholders and mental health education.
Have basic communication skills and a sense of ethics as a psychotherapist.
